card.name: Ovarian cancer and respiratory infection risk
card.fires_on: The word ovarian (or its pieces) right after 'increased risk of' in hormone-therapy warnings. Also fires on upper or lower respiratory tract infection terms in infection-risk statements.

modes.label: Ovarian cancer risk
modes.description: The word ovarian, or its pieces, naming a cancer risk linked to estrogen plus progestin.
modes.example: estrogen plus progestin increased the risk of<< ovarian>> cancer.

modes.label: Respiratory infections
modes.description: Upper or lower respiratory tract infection terms in statements about infection risk.
modes.example: Ocrelizumab increases the risk for<< upper>> respiratory tract infections
